notes.title: NO UPDATES
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I apologize for being a socially divergent person.
I've neglected updates due to my miserable job and other personal issues, so I've overlooked the story and bugs in the game..... XD ..... Despite being a very clear inspiration from you-know-what,I really want it to be a fun game, but I'm missing heavy machinery. For that reason, I apologize for not updating the game and meeting its goal of being entertaining. That said, I hope to finish my tasks and laugh happily

ːsteamhappyː I hope to be able to turn the machine back on in the coming months, unless the world ends sooner than expected, I don't know.

notes.title: Only UP Girl: Friend
notes.notes:
hello everyone!
I am pleased to share with you a new update where the following was added:

1- New 3D models
2- New sounds
3- New music
4- Map Improvement
5- Friends Ranking

Ranking Rules:
- The Ranking will have a score related to time and objects collected. The shorter the time, the higher the score.
- There will be a Global Ranking and Friends Ranking for each Zone
- When a map modification is made, the ranking will restart.
- You will not be able to view the Ranking until you participate (Click the red button where the Ranking is located)


INVITE YOUR FRIENDS! To see who is the Best. [I will also participate in the Ranking, so, go, GET OVER ME]


I'm sorry if there is a problem that affects the game experience, in that case please share it in the discussion groups so it can be resolved hehe

And nothing more; thank you very much to all

Only UP Girl awaits you
